eligibilitySummary.ro: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from recognized university.
eligibilitySummary.aro: Bachelor's Degree + DOEACC / NIELIT 'O' Level (or UP Govt approved equivalent) + Hindi Typing on Computer (25 WPM in Kruti Dev 010 / Mangal font). English typing 30 WPM given preference.

selectionProcess: Stage 1: Preliminary Exam (Objective - 200 Marks: 140 GS + 60 Hindi)
Stage 2: Main Examination (400 Marks: 120 GS + 160 General Hindi & Drafting + 120 Hindi Essay)
Stage 3: Hindi Typing Qualification Test (Compulsory for ARO posts on Computer)
No Interview for RO/ARO (Direct Selection on Mains + Typing Qualification)
